statements: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_flows (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	scene VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'diagnosis' NOT NULL, 
	draft JSONB NOT NULL, 
	draft_revision INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	published JSONB, 
	published_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	published_revision INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	archived BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entry_route_flows (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	draft JSONB NOT NULL, 
	draft_revision INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	published JSONB, 
	published_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	published_revision INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	archived BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT entry_route_flows_revisions CHECK (draft_revision > 0 AND published_version >= 0 AND published_revision >= 0 AND published_revision <= draft_revision), 
	CONSTRAINT entry_route_flows_enabled_published CHECK (NOT enabled OR (published IS NOT NULL AND published_version > 0 AND NOT archived))
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intent_samples (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	route VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	text VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	embedding VECTOR(1024), 
	source VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'manual' NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_bases (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	category VARCHAR(100), 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	chunk_size_tokens INTEGER, 
	chunk_overlap_tokens INTEGER, 
	separator_mode VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'auto', 
	custom_separator VARCHAR(100), 
	chunk_structure VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'paragraph', 
	child_chunk_size_tokens INTEGER, 
	child_chunk_overlap_tokens INTEGER, 
	remove_extra_spaces BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	remove_urls_emails BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_query_logs (
	kb_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	query VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'hybrid' NOT NULL, 
	results INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'hit_testing' NOT NULL, 
	elapsed_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_regression_test_sets (
	kb_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS route_classification_logs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(64), 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	user_message VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	route VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	top_matches JSONB, 
	latency_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255), 
	avatar_url VARCHAR(500), 
	role VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_flow_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	flow_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	draft_revision INTEGER, 
	snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	test BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	records JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	output JSONB, 
	error TEXT, 
	cancel_requested BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(flow_id) REFERENCES agent_flows (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_teams (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	definition JSONB NOT NULL, 
	tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	run_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	last_run_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_keys (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	last_used TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	revoked BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '新对话' NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'agent_chat' NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(64), 
	intent VARCHAR(100), 
	rating VARCHAR(20), 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active', 
	customer_meta JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entry_route_flow_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	flow_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	draft_revision INTEGER, 
	snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	assistant_message_id VARCHAR(36), 
	test BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	input_summary VARCHAR(2000) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	records JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	output JSONB, 
	terminal_node_id VARCHAR(100), 
	error TEXT, 
	duration_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT entry_route_flow_runs_status CHECK (status IN ('running', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(flow_id) REFERENCES entry_route_flows (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_documents (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	knowledge_base_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	chunk_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	original_filename VARCHAR(500), 
	original_file_type VARCHAR(100), 
	original_file_size INTEGER, 
	original_file_path VARCHAR(1000), 
	error_message VARCHAR(2000), 
	retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	quality_label VARCHAR(20), 
	processing_detail TEXT, 
	processing_started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	downloading_completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	parsing_completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	normalizing_completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	chunking_completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	embedding_completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_base_id) REFERENCES knowledge_bases (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_regression_cases (
	test_set_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kb_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	query VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	expected_top_k INTEGER DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL, 
	min_score FLOAT, 
	search_method VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'hybrid' NOT NULL, 
	top_k INTEGER DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL, 
	reranking_enable BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	score_threshold FLOAT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	expected_doc_titles JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	expected_doc_ids JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	required_text JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	forbidden_text JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	prompt_required_context_text JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(test_set_id) REFERENCES knowledge_regression_test_sets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_regression_runs (
	test_set_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kb_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	total_cases INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	passed_cases INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	failed_cases INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	hit_rate FLOAT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	average_rank FLOAT, 
	average_elapsed_ms FLOAT, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(test_set_id) REFERENCES knowledge_regression_test_sets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS refresh_tokens (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflows (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	definition JSONB NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL, 
	tags VARCHAR[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	run_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	last_run_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	task TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	scratchpad JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	final_summary TEXT, 
	compressed_summary TEXT, 
	runtime_state JSONB, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_team_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	team_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	task TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	messages JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	blackboard JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint JSONB, 
	output JSONB, 
	error TEXT, 
	rounds_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(team_id) REFERENCES agent_teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_memory (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT, 
	covered_until_message_id VARCHAR(36), 
	token_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	memory_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'summary' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_chunks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	knowledge_base_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	token_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(20), 
	quality_label VARCHAR(20), 
	parent_chunk_id VARCHAR(36), 
	embedding VECTOR(1024), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES knowledge_documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_chunk_id) REFERENCES knowledge_chunks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(knowledge_base_id) REFERENCES knowledge_bases (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_regression_run_items (
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	case_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	rank INTEGER, 
	score FLOAT, 
	matched_doc_id VARCHAR(36), 
	failure_reason VARCHAR(2000), 
	results_snapshot JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	prompt_snapshot TEXT, 
	elapsed_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES knowledge_regression_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(case_id) REFERENCES knowledge_regression_cases (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'text' NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	metadata JSON, 
	model VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS satisfaction_ratings (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	message_id VARCHAR(36), 
	rating VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	comment TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	workflow_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL, 
	input JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	output JSONB, 
	checkpoint JSONB, 
	current_step_id VARCHAR(100), 
	progress JSONB DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(workflow_id) REFERENCES workflows (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_approvals (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	step_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tool_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	tool_args JSONB NOT NULL, 
	risk_level VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	approved_by VARCHAR(36), 
	modified_args JSONB, 
	rejection_reason VARCHAR(500), 
	timeout_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 300000 NOT NULL, 
	requested_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	decided_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workflow_step_logs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	step_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	step_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	input JSONB, 
	output JSONB, 
	error TEXT, 
	retry_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	tokens_used INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	events JSONB DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entry_route_flows_one_enabled ON entry_route_flows ((true)) WHERE enabled = true

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_flow_runs_flow_id_created_at_idx ON agent_flow_runs (flow_id, created_at)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_teams_updated_at_idx ON agent_teams (updated_at)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversations_type_created ON conversations (type, created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversations_user_id ON conversations (user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_conversations_user_updated ON conversations (user_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entry_route_flow_runs_conversation_id_idx ON entry_route_flow_runs (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS entry_route_flow_runs_flow_id_created_at_id_idx ON entry_route_flow_runs (flow_id, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_knowledge_documents_kb_id ON knowledge_documents (knowledge_base_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_regression_cases_kb ON knowledge_regression_cases (kb_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_regression_cases_test_set ON knowledge_regression_cases (test_set_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_regression_runs_created ON knowledge_regression_runs (created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_regression_runs_kb ON knowledge_regression_runs (kb_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_regression_runs_test_set ON knowledge_regression_runs (test_set_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_refresh_tokens_token_hash ON refresh_tokens (token_hash)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_refresh_tokens_user_id ON refresh_tokens (user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_workflows_user_id ON workflows (user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_workflows_user_status ON workflows (user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_agent_sessions_conversation_id ON agent_sessions (conversation_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_team_runs_started_at_idx ON agent_team_runs (started_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_team_runs_status_idx ON agent_team_runs (status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_team_runs_team_id_idx ON agent_team_runs (team_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_team_runs_user_id_idx ON agent_team_runs (user_id)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_regression_run_items_run ON knowledge_regression_run_items (run_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_messages_conversation_created ON messages (conversation_id, created_at)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_workflow_step_logs_run_step ON workflow_step_logs (run_id, step_id)
